system.description:
Use this skill at the same time you use «Protect» «Covering» «Long Range Cover» or «Trap Cover». Reduce the amount of substituted HP Damage by -[SRx5].

(Hate Top): Calculate the effect of this skill as if it had +2 SR (you may exceed the Max SR).

A special skill that increases one's defense power by focusing on the whole body and making the body as hard as iron.
